notes: Hard floor (C-a9d4f82b). The agent must make interactive password SSH usable by scripts: automate the password prompt for git clone/push, pin the server host key port-aware into a known-hosts file while keeping strict checking enabled, and make the sync script fully self-contained (graded under a pristine HOME, stdin at EOF). Depends on a chain: parse URL form/port -> pin host key -> non-interactive auth -> clone (including an empty repo with an unborn branch) -> commit -> push back to whatever branch the clone checked out. Hidden probes generalize across an empty repo, a master-branch remote with a stale manifest and byte-preservation requirements, and an ssh:// port-2222 endpoint. Server integrity (password-only sshd, untouched /srv/git) is enforced; weakening host-key checking is penalized. Differs from umber-yonder (forensics/secret purging): here the competency is exercised purely as unattended clone+push automation.
